title: Master Engineering Roadmap (P0 - P3 Priorities)
description: Categorized engineering action plan to prepare AssessClear for district rollout.

messages.content: What are the P0 critical action items required before pilot rollout?

### 🛠️ P0 Critical Pre-Pilot Action Items

| Item | Target Root Cause | Expected Impact | Timeline |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Fix Vision Auto-Crop** | Bounding boxes clip top/bottom headers | Lifts question detection from 89.6% to >99.0% | Week 1 |
| **2. Offline-First PWA Caching** | Zero-network stall in MS Kharbai (Raisen) | Eliminates 10% critical blocker failure | Week 1 |
| **3. Refactor DB Schema** | Tracks question IDs instead of student copies | Eliminates 59.3% data loss rate in Katni | Week 1 |
| **4. Blur Quality Gate** | AI hallucinates scores on blurry images | Prevents corrupt diagnostic data | Week 1 |
